title: Fishing Adventures of South Padre Island

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Pretty much the only thing around during the winter is Red Snapper. Its a great time of year to fish for them.We catch limits regularly and sometimes very quickly. These trips are up to 6 hours or when we catch our limits. During Federal Water Red Snapper Season, we head towards one of our many rocks, wrecks or reefs that hold the Huge Red Snapper in Federal Waters. We will troll along the way looking for Kingfish, Spanish Mackerel and Mahi Mahi if they are around. Once we reach our spot, we will setup to bottom fish for Red Snapper, then if time allows, we will troll back. Our 6 hour trips are mostly nearshore trolling trips. When Federal Water Snapper season is closed we target Kingfish,
